talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 27 solo PCPs winding down in Arizona; 4 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Mesa 85206, Surprise 85374, Peoria 85381) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~2,883 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Pinal County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 7 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~126,000 patients across 105 at-risk practices statewide.
